note: Both sets are heavily redundant, but Set B binds values and conditions more faithfully: it correctly captures the flame prohibition during contest week, the host-team decathlete functions, and the wastewater rule, with mostly verbatim quotes. Set A invents or alters several quotes and conditions — e.g. it rewrites the food/beverage preparation rule as "during the competition" instead of the Appendix A-3 period, changes "instructions on the packaging" to "manufacturer's instructions," and misquotes the non-decathlete and guest-composition rules. Set B's main error is the flame claim misbound to "during cooking/preparing the meal" with an invented quote, plus two garbled numeric quotes; Set A also omits the flame safety rule entirely.
